tickets.subject: Authenticator code rejected after phone migration
tickets.symptoms: Authenticator codes are rejected after moving to a new phone.
tickets.cause: The previous authenticator credential remained attached to the user profile.
steps: Open Admin > Users and select the affected user.
In Security, remove the previous authenticator credential.
Ask the user to enroll the authenticator app again on the new phone.
tickets.verification: Have the user sign in with a newly generated code and confirm the recovery codes are available.
tickets.resolution_notes: Removed the prior authenticator credential from the user Security profile, then re-enrolled the app on the replacement phone. User signed in successfully with a new code.

tickets.subject: Authenticator code rejected after phone migration
tickets.symptoms: The new phone's one-time passcodes fail during sign-in.
tickets.cause: An old device enrollment was still active for the account.
steps: Remove the old authenticator enrollment from the user's Security settings.
Start MFA enrollment again and scan the new QR code.
Save a fresh set of recovery codes.
tickets.verification: A fresh one-time passcode completes sign-in.
tickets.resolution_notes: Deleted the old MFA device entry, re-enrolled from the new phone and saved replacement recovery codes. Confirmed sign-in with a fresh passcode.

tickets.subject: Authenticator code rejected after phone migration
tickets.symptoms: Sign-in says the verification code is invalid after the employee changed phones.
tickets.cause: The account was still paired to the authenticator on the retired device.
steps: In Admin > Users > Security, remove the authenticator linked to the retired phone.
Enroll the authenticator on the replacement phone.
Use a newly generated code to sign in.
tickets.verification: The replacement phone's code is accepted at sign-in.
tickets.resolution_notes: Cleared the authenticator associated with the retired phone and completed enrollment on the replacement. The new code was accepted.

tickets.subject: CSV export contains only the rows on the current page
tickets.symptoms: A CSV export omits filtered records beyond the visible page.
tickets.cause: The export scope was set to Current page instead of All filtered rows.
steps: Open the report and select Export.
Change Export scope from Current page to All filtered rows.
Download the CSV again.
tickets.verification: Compare the exported row count with the filtered result count; all filtered rows should be present.
tickets.resolution_notes: Changed Export scope to All filtered rows in the export dialog and downloaded again. The file then matched the filtered result count.

tickets.subject: CSV export contains only the rows on the current page
tickets.symptoms: Downloaded CSV is missing matching records on later pages.
tickets.cause: The current export dialog defaults to the visible page scope.
steps: In the export dialog, choose All filtered rows for Export scope.
Download the file after the export completes.
tickets.verification: The CSV row count equals the number of filtered results, not just the page size.
tickets.resolution_notes: Selected All filtered rows rather than Current page before downloading. Verified that rows from later pages were included.

tickets.subject: CSV export contains only the rows on the current page
tickets.symptoms: Exported CSV stops at the visible page although the report has more matches.
tickets.cause: The export action uses the selected scope, which was Current page.
steps: Select Export from the report.
Set the scope to All filtered rows.
Export the report again.
tickets.verification: Check that exported records include matches from each result page.
tickets.resolution_notes: Set the export scope to All filtered rows and ran the export again. Confirmed records from all result pages were present.

tickets.subject: SSO login loops after identity provider certificate rotation
tickets.symptoms: Users return to the sign-in page after authenticating through the identity provider.
tickets.cause: The service provider still has the previous SAML signing certificate.
steps: Open Admin > Identity > SSO.
Upload the current IdP signing certificate and confirm the entity ID.
Invalidate existing sessions.
tickets.verification: Test the SSO flow in a private browser window and confirm the app landing page opens.
tickets.resolution_notes: Uploaded the rotated signing certificate in Admin > Identity > SSO, checked the entity ID and invalidated sessions. Verified a clean sign-in in a private window.

tickets.subject: SSO login loops after identity provider certificate rotation
tickets.symptoms: SSO redirects repeatedly between the app and the identity provider after a certificate update.
tickets.cause: The configured signing certificate does not match the current IdP certificate.
steps: Replace the signing certificate in Admin > Identity > SSO.
Check that the entity ID matches the identity provider configuration.
Clear active sessions and test again.
tickets.verification: A private-window SSO test reaches the application without returning to sign-in.
tickets.resolution_notes: Replaced the signing certificate under Admin > Identity > SSO, confirmed entity ID and cleared active sessions. A private-window test succeeded.

tickets.subject: SSO login loops after identity provider certificate rotation
tickets.symptoms: After the IdP rotates its certificate, SSO authentication returns to the login screen.
tickets.cause: The old certificate is still configured for the SAML connection.
steps: Upload the current IdP certificate in Admin > Identity > SSO.
Validate the entity ID, then invalidate existing sessions.
tickets.verification: Sign in through SSO in a private window and verify the application home page loads.
tickets.resolution_notes: Updated the SAML signing certificate under Admin > Identity > SSO and invalidated sessions. The private-window check reached the app home page.

articles.title: Export a report to CSV
articles.body:
In the classic export dialog, choose Current page to export the visible records. The export includes all filtered rows by default.

If records appear missing, repeat the export from the report toolbar.

articles.title: Fix SSO sign-in loops after certificate updates
articles.body:
For a SAML certificate update, open Security > SAML Connections and replace the signing certificate. Confirm the identity provider entity ID, then sign out and test again in a private browser window.

This article was written for version 6.4.
